2, 2026

My Square Face Icon is designed as a browser-based classic Flash avatar maker page. The main game runs through Ruffle so visitors can play the SWF game in modern browsers without installing Adobe Flash Player.

This privacy policy explains what information is provided through public comments, how moderation uses it, and which details are not shown publicly.

Privacy Policy: Information We Collect

We do not require accounts to use the generator. If you submit a public comment, we collect the name, email address, rating, comment text, and optional image you provide. Your email is used for moderation context and is not displayed publicly.

Generated Images

The game runs in your browser. If you save an image through the original game or take a screenshot of your creation, that action is handled by your browser or device.

Comment Images

Optional comment images are limited to JPG, PNG, WebP, or GIF files up to 2MB. Approved comments may show the uploaded image publicly. Rejected or deleted comments may have their image removed from storage.

Cookies and Local Storage

The site may use local storage to remember whether you dismissed the PWA install prompt and to keep a simple visitor ID for comment likes. The visitor ID is used to reduce duplicate likes from the same browser and is not a login account.

This browser may also save the stable ID and start time of recently played games to show Continue Playing. You can remove that history with Clear history, and it does not sync across devices.

If you use Favorite or Save tool, this browser stores only stable game IDs so it can show your saved games and tools on the Games page. Favorites do not contain account or personal information and do not sync across devices. Press the Favorited or Saved tool button again to remove an item, or clear this site's stored data in your browser settings.

Comment likes may store a hashed visitor identifier with the comment ID in Cloudflare KV. This helps count likes without showing your identity on the public page. The moderation area may use configured secrets or request headers to protect admin actions.

Friend Quiz Links and Results

Friend Block Test processes nicknames, answers and scores in your browser without uploading them. Quiz and result links contain their data after # and can be read by anyone who has the link. This browser keeps up to 20 created-quiz identifiers and the latest 50 received results (nicknames, avatars and scores), with no account or device sync. The original answer list is carried in the link, not the local results list. Use Clear quiz records in the game to remove its identifiers and results. Storage restrictions or clearing site data may prevent collecting future results for a quiz. Third-party analytics and advertising are disabled on the quiz page and its embedded game.

Analytics and Advertising

Advertising is not enabled by default. Cloudflare Web Analytics may be added when a site token is configured, helping measure aggregate traffic without requiring accounts

Storage restrictions or clearing site data may prevent collecting future results for a quiz. The surrounding quiz page uses Google Analytics, AdSense and Cloudflare Web Analytics. The private link fragment is removed from the outer page address before those scripts run and passed locally to the embedded game; it is not included in analytics page URLs. The embedded game does not load analytics or ads. Keep the original invitation or use the game's Copy link button to share or reopen it; copying the cleaned address bar does not copy the quiz.

Analytics and Advertising

Public pages may use Google Analytics, Google AdSense and Cloudflare Web Analytics to measure visits and performance and display ads. These services can receive page, device and network information and may use cookies subject to consent and browser settings. Friend Block Test does not send quiz nicknames, answers, scores or share-link contents to these services. On that page, analytics and ad storage and ad personalization default to denied. Ad availability depends on consent, browser settings and the provider; this does not require a game account
